en: K-Kaito!

Keebo, are you okay!? You got hit 
by that debris when you protec-

I-I'm...fine.
More importantly...
Ghghghgh...!

What's the matter, Monokuma!?
Upset that Kaito won!?
Eh? Whaddaya mean Kaito won?
He died before the end of your punishment.
Kaito didn't die from your execution!

Th-That's right!
Kaito wasn't killed by you!
It's...Kaito's victory.
Wah! We lost!

Hmph... I dunno if he meant to do it, but he
certainly went out like a stubborn jackass.

Well, whatever! It's not like this is the end
of the killing game! So it's fine!
It's...not over?
Hell yeah! No shit!
Ain't it written in the school regulations?

The killing game will go on until there is just
one blackened or two spotless.

School regulations... So you're gonna follow
the regulations, huh?

The only reason you want rules is because
you're <CLT=cltSTRONG>showing this to someone<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

...I just want an entertaining killing game, but
you're certainly entitled to your opinion.

That's...enough!
Enough of your bullshit, Monokuma!

I made a promise to Kaito!
I will end this killing game!

And to give Kaito's death meaning, I swear
I *will* keep my promise!

Yeah! We're not going to let
anyone else die!

Who's even gonna play that game
anymore!? It's already over!

Hmm... You could cut this tension with a knife.
What's everyone talkin' about, anyway?

Feels like we stumbled into the last act.
I dunno what's happenin' at all!

Yo Pops! Fill us in!
We wanna help ya out!

Oh! Monosuke is acting nice!
He's sucking up for brownie points!

Ohhhh, I just can't help myself around
you cute little cubs.

Gather 'round, kids. I'll spend a whole month
telling you about what you missed.

A whole month!? Won't that take longer
than the whole chapter!?

I'll tell you all about it, while I smother you
with hugs and kisses!

You kids go on ahead and wait for me
at home.
Okay! So long, bear-well!

Hm? Why did I stay behind? Cuz I wanna
give you all a reward for working so hard.

We don't want it!
Just go away!

By the way...I dunno where you got the idea
that this killing game can be stopped.

There's nothing a <CLT=cltSTRONG>participant<CLT=typeNORMAL> can do to
end this killing game.

No way! Nuh-uh! This game is gonna keep
going and going for a long time!

<CLT=cltMIND>During his ranting, Monokuma
took out...
Huh? A Flashback Light!?
Urgh... Gah...
W-What? What did you just do?
Was that...a Flashback Light just now?

Is it...broken?
I don't feel like I remembered anything.

Puhuhu... This <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL> has a
special effect.
You'll remember soon enough...

You'll remember that <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> is the only
choice you have.
And that <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> doesn't exist here at all!

Ah-hahahahaha!
The killing game will never end!
<CLT=cltMIND>And then...Monokuma left.

<CLT=cltMIND>He declared that this killing game
would continue.

<CLT=cltMIND>He declared...there is
no <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>After all that, I honestly don't
remember how we got back.

<CLT=cltMIND>It took all I had just to accept the
reality that Kaito was gone...

<CLT=cltMIND>And not just Kaito...
Kokichi too...

<CLT=cltMIND>Someone we all trusted, and someone
none of us trusted... We lost them both.
<CLT=cltMIND>But it wasn't all for nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because we're drawing ever closer
to discovering the <CLT=cltSTRONG>true mastermind<CLT=cltMIND>...
The killing game will never end...
Never ever!

As long as I'm around, it'll never end.
It'll repeat over and over and over...

Why would I let something this fun
ever end? I want to have more fun.

As long as it's fun, we have 
to keep doing it.
That's just simple supply and demand.
Puhuhuhuhu...
Puhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhuhu.
Such...despair.
